description: COVID-GM-RESCORE-02: re-score the held-out Greg Mortimer hull under the post-DP-era engine. The Diamond-Princess believability line has since landed a stack of default-ON mechanisms the RESCORE-01 image (591d21b1, measured) did not carry; this design asks whether the same held-out lattice still lands. Grammar verbatim from COVID-GM-RESCORE-01: the scenario is the fixed split's held-out hull (split_role 'held_out', declared here and verified against the split at load), Theta is the same three declared rows (composite Theta is a pathogen constant -- no per-hull refit, and THETA-REFIT-01 measured NO-ADMISSIBLE on the shipped-default tree so no successor admissible lattice exists to adopt), and the arms are the same two labelled hand-reservoir columns. Cells: greg_mortimer_2020 as-declared x hand_reservoir_mode {hygiene_cycle (shipped baseline, empty overrides), spike_decay (labelled baseline)} x Theta {1e11, 2.37e11, 1e12} x 50 seeds @20200205 = 300 cells, plus the imports:3 diagnostic (covid_gm_rescore_v2_imports3, 50 cells). Same seed block as every conditioned design since v1, so each v2 row sits opposite its v1 row at identical (theta, arm, seed list); the v1-vs-v2 read is distribution-level per row -- engine drift re-rolls RNG streams wherever new machinery reaches, so per-seed bit-pairing is not claimed (the stochastic-attribution convention), and the declared drift inventory below is the attribution map.
supersedes: nothing -- v2 is a fresh held-out score on the same anchors. COVID-GM-RESCORE-01's rows stay measured at 591d21b1; this design re-measures the same grammar at the merged SHA and reads the delta distribution-level, never as a repin.
prerequisites: COVID-GM-RESCORE-01 (docs/ledger/COVID-GM-RESCORE-01.md, measured at 591d21b1): verdict mixed -- H1 lands at both higher thetas on both arms, q05 tail sits at 1 (ignition-or-bust), asymptomatic share misses H2's 0.81 +/- 0.10 by ~10x (medians 0.026-0.122); imports:3 rescues the fizzle tail completely. The frozen grammar, audit shape and verdict classes below are inherited unchanged.

THETA-REFIT-01 (docs/covid/covid_theta_refit_v1_readout.md): NO-ADMISSIBLE on the shipped-default tree -- the v11-lineage clause fails at every quarter-decade theta, so no successor conditioning lattice exists; the v13 rows {1e11, 2.37e11, 1e12} stand verbatim.

Shipped default-ON since 591d21b1 that reaches the GM voyage (attribution inventory, not arms): CAREGIVER-V1 / CAREGIVER-SVC-01 / MEAL-SVC-02 -- R3 service deliveries to confined hosts carrying contact_factor_to_host attenuation (the door-drop channel fires under GM's SOP-017); PROPENSITY-V1 -- rhythm.participation_propensity party-keyed persistent propensity; HOST-AGE-01 -- susceptibility_by_age_band (Ayoub ladder) + symptomatic_fraction_by_age_band (Wang 2022 spline) on sars_cov2_resp, the direct hit on the H2 miss's composition side; PRESENT-SHARE-01 -- presentation_draw_mode resolves once_per_course (the per-day symptomatic re-roll that contributed to the v1-era onset inflation is gone); DEFIANT-ESC-01 -- defiant refusers escalate to enforced confinement after a declared hold-out; ISO-QUARTERS-01 -- service pickup reads the stateroom compartment. Campaign-arm machinery (crew-mess directive, berth/work-cohort, window counterfactuals) and the norovirus-scoped legs (FOOD-COMMON-SOURCE objects, emesis deposit) do not fire on an as-declared covid replay.

campaigns/ + scripts/campaign path: this campaign registers under campaigns/covid/gm_rescore_02/ and submits through the generic jobdef/entrypoint; the legacy deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh + per-campaign Dockerfile path v1 used is the frozen layout this replaces.
split_role_note: Declared in writing before any cell ran: this design scores the split's held-out hull. load_design verifies the declaration against the fixed split (a mismatch refuses at load); the field being absent on every prior design keeps them on the fit-target gate unchanged.

cell_conditioning.note: As-declared replay of the greg_mortimer_2020 scenario record: explicit seed is one passenger at epoch 0 with infection_age_days 0.0 (a declared assumption in the scenario file, deliberately identical to the training hull's convention), scheduled SOP-017 cabin isolation voyage day 8 -> end_day 27, single ship-wide testing campaign voyage day 20 (everyone tier), molecular_ascertainment_start_day 20 (no specimen channel before the screen), boarding channel off, platform expedition_cruise_450 declared not fitted. imports axis holds the declared 1; the imports:3 probe lives in covid_gm_rescore_v2_imports3, not here.
cell_conditioning.theta: 1e11 | 2.37e11 | 1e12 -- the v13 conditioning lattice verbatim (kept for row-pairing with v1; no successor admissible set exists to adopt)
cell_conditioning.split_day_note: On GM the scored date cut is the day-20 screen (split_day 20 -> onsets_before/on_or_after_split_day straddle the campaign) and the window pair is the day-8 isolation order (turn_day 8 -> the +/-7d passenger/crew onset counts bracket the confinement). The observables layer stays record-honest: campaign counts come from the campaign specimen log only.

arms.note: Shipped default since PR #804 -- the practice cycle (compliance-gated post-visit washes, routine washes, self-contact re-loading, wet-window deposit blend). Empty overrides per the baseline-arm convention; the engine resolves hand_reservoir_mode hygiene_cycle and the delivery block echoes it. Under v2 this arm also carries the whole post-DP-era default stack the v1 image lacked -- that is the point of the rescore.

Labelled baseline column, kept so the v2 lattice is row-for-row pairable with v1: the hand-reservoir sensitivity read (v1 measured ~0 deltas on GM) is re-measured under drift -- a nonzero v2 delta says hand physics became load-bearing on the held-out leg, a repeat null retires the axis on GM.

cells_note: 3 Theta x 2 arms x 50 seeds = 300 cells, declared-replay (~5 min each on the 223-agent hull; measure from the canary). Cell order is theta x arm x seed: cells 0-99 = Theta 1e11 (hygiene_cycle 0-49, spike_decay 50-99), 100-199 = Theta 2.37e11 (hygiene_cycle 100-149, spike_decay 150-199), 200-299 = Theta 1e12.

metrics: per-seed recorded_onsets (takeoff channel: >=10), campaign_positives / campaign_specimens / asymptomatic_share from the day-20 campaign log, infections_total and attack_rate
P(takeoff >=10 recorded onsets) per (theta, arm) row
campaign_positives median + q05-q95 per row vs H1's 128 of 217 (share 0.5899)
asymptomatic_share among positives per row vs H2's 0.8125 (defined cells only)
recorded-onsets attack share per seed vs covid.H3's Willebrand IQR [0.0003, 0.015] (median 0.002, mean 0.037) -- a tail-placement read, the right tail is expected
takeoff-conditional campaign_positives (the count among ignited seeds only -- separates ignition failure from size failure)
onset timing: first_onset_day median + pooled onset_curve day mass per row, under the day-20 screen channel
seed-paired spike_decay - hygiene_cycle deltas on recorded_onsets, campaign_positives, infections_total, and takeoff-class flips per theta

v2-vs-v1 row deltas: per (theta, arm) row, the v2 surface against v1's frozen rows on the identical seed list -- distribution-level (medians, q05-q95, takeoff share), attributed to the shipped-mechanism inventory by name; per-seed pairing is NOT claimed (engine drift re-rolls RNG streams wherever new machinery reaches)
freeze.verdict_grammar: replays | under_fires | over_fires | mixed -- same grammar as v1. A row 'lands H1' when its campaign_positives median sits within 2x of 128 ([64, 256]) with the q05-q95 interval containing 128. 'replays' needs the anchor row (theta 2.37e11, hygiene_cycle) to land H1 AND H2's median asymptomatic share within 0.81 +/- 0.10; 'under_fires' = the anchor row's positives median lands under 64 or takeoff probability under 0.5; 'over_fires' = median over 256; 'mixed' = the arms or theta rows split verdicts or H1 lands with H2 outside its band. The v2-specific reads, declared now: (a) H2 movement direction -- once_per_course + age-graded presentation are the levers v1's ~10x asym miss predicted could move it, and the v2 medians either close toward 0.71-0.91 or confirm the miss is not a presentation-draw artefact; (b) ignition tail -- whether the ~1-in-5 fizzle rate survives the door-drop/service-channel machinery; (c) envelope width -- whether PROPENSITY-V1's persistent propensity narrows or widens the ignited-seed ~4x spread v1 measured.

admissibility.note: No selection criterion -- this is a scoring pass on held-out anchors measured as-declared, not a screen and not a fit. Nothing here moves Theta or any constant; the lattice is fixed at the three declared rows.
audit_invariants: delivery.hand_reservoir_mode echoes the cell's arm on every payload (hygiene_cycle on the baseline arm, spike_decay on the baseline-labelled arm) -- the arm channel fired, or the cell is a defect.
delivery.presentation_draw_mode echoes 'once_per_course' on every payload (the shipped presentation draw; anything else means the shipped tree did not reach the cell).
delivery.caregiver resolved block present on every payload (the R3 service deliveries the SOP-017 door-drop channel runs on; absent = a shipped-mechanism echo failure).
delivery.participation_propensity resolved on every payload that reaches the rhythm layer (PROPENSITY-V1 echo; a hull with no rhythm catalog resolves None and that is declared, not a defect).

seed_ring.seed_spec echoes the declared seed on every cell (count == the cell's imports axis, infection_age_days 0.0, role passenger; onset_day/departure_day absent -- GM's record carries neither) and seeded_count matches.
cell pairing is keyed on (theta, seed) across arms; a payload whose cell key is not on this lattice is a failure by construction.
every cell is a 672-epoch declared replay of greg_mortimer_2020 (28 days, 1-hour epochs) with aboard_total 223 -- truncated voyages or wrong hull are defects.
admissibility.report_immediately_if: the anchor row loses H1 where v1 landed it (the DP-era stack broke the held-out leg in the tightening direction); P(takeoff) ~= 0 at anchor theta on either arm (the import/early-contact regime is dead under current physics); the v2 asymptomatic share lands H2 (the presentation-draw + age-grade repair closed the ~10x miss -- re-orders every queued session); or a seed-paired spike_decay - hygiene_cycle delta goes materially nonzero where v1 measured ~0 (hand physics became load-bearing on GM).

execution.platform: AWS Batch via the campaigns/ path: campaigns/covid/gm_rescore_02/ declares the blocks; scripts/campaign renders a digest-pinned rev of the generic deploy/aws/campaign_jobdef.json onto the picard-campaign image built at the merged design SHA (root Dockerfile + deploy/aws/Dockerfile.campaign overlay); the generic deploy/aws/campaign_entrypoint.py maps each array index to (block, seed) and uploads cell_{seed}.json per block.
execution.expected_cell_minutes: ~5 (223-agent hull, 672 epochs; measure from the canary, not from the DP 30-min figure)
execution.queue: picard-analysis-queue (crew_berth_01 precedent for ~5-min covid cells; dedup makes a later Spot dual-submit safe if the queue proves thin)
execution.canary: the anchor-row canary block (theta 2.37e11 x hygiene_cycle x seeds 20200205-20200224 = 20 cells, a contiguous prefix of the t2e11_hygiene block's seed list) lands under canary_t2e11_hygiene/ and is audited before anything else submits: audit invariants green on all 20, voyage non-degenerate, then STOP AND REPORT per the campaign gate; the seven fleet blocks (6 scoring + imports3) run only on the author's go-ahead.
execution.readout: tools/covid_gm_rescore_readout.py --cells campaign_results/covid_gm_rescore_v2/cells --design picard_framework/runs/covid_gm_rescore_v2_design.json --pair-cells campaign_results/covid_gm_rescore_v2_imports3/cells (sync each block's prefix and merge into the flat cells dirs; payloads carry (theta, arm_id, seed) so block prefixes pool cleanly)
